text: Si lorra heɓii yedduɗo, wono ñawu maa sattireede arsike maa hulugol yoolaade, o toroo nde Joomi makko hunciranta mo ɗum, ruttagol e Makko, Kanko tun. Refti non, si Allah neeminirii mo huncangol mo on lorra, o yejjita fii Allah, Mo O torotonoo On, ado ɗum. O waɗana Mo kafidiiɗi, reweteeɗi, ko wanaa Allah, no o majjinira woɗɓe goo, e laawol Allah ngol. Nulaaɗo, maakan sugu on ɗon : dakmitor yeddugol maa ngol, yeru ko o heddoriɗaa e duuɓi kon. Anndaa pellet, ko a jeyaaɗo e yimɓe duumoytooɓe ka Yiite ɓen, Ñalnde Darngal.
